resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register gives Sequoia National Park, administered by the National Park Service. The Forest Lookouts page heads its entry Sequoia National Forest. The story reports both and does not choose.

notes_for_editor: Only two pages with substance were available: the register entry and the Forest Lookouts page. The construction date is 'circa 1931' per the Thornton Survey, and the May 1931 newspaper item shows the lookout in use by then. The land manager is disputed: National Park Service and Sequoia National Park on the register, Sequoia National Forest on the Forest Lookouts page. The brief's access 'unknown' stands. The status 'gone' rests only on the FFLA list; no source describes removal or the site today. A WebSearch surfaced a Sequoia and Kings Canyon historic photo record (calisphere.org, item 190e4fcea67a2073300486ec4dd7b2db) tagged 1930 for pack materials to the Paradise Peak lookout site; the page returned no readable text, so it is not cited. A reviewer who can open it could confirm a 1930 construction start and the NPS attribution. Photos: none new.
